access.tempPasswordHtml: The password you were given is temporary: at your next sign-in the app will ask you to choose your own password, which nobody else knows.
access.resetHtml: You will find the link to choose a new password in the recovery email, or your professional will hand it to you directly. The link is valid for one hour and can be used once.
access.warningHtml: If you did not request this, contact your professional before using the link or the password, and change the password as soon as you sign in.
access.tempPasswordText: The password you were given is temporary: at your next sign-in the app will ask you to choose your own password.
access.resetText: The link to choose a new password is valid for one hour and can be used once.
access.warningText: If you did not request this, contact your professional before using the link or the password.
access.footer: This email is an automatic notice: you will receive it every time someone acts on your access.

resetLink.body: here is the link to get back into your Stress Index app and choose a new password:
resetLink.note: It is valid for one hour and can be used once. If it has expired, let me know and I will send you another one.
